description: Open Data Lëtzebuerg: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Lëtzebuerg. Coverage: Open Data Lëtzebuerg. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Electricity in Luxembourg - Actual Total load; Electricity in Luxembourg - Cross-Border Physical Flows 2022-2025; Electricity in Luxembourg - Actual Generation per Production Type; Electricity in Luxembourg - Installed Capacity per Production Type. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is notspecified, cc-by. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
